prompt: Which component expands a server’s I/O capabilities, often adding a GPU, network interface or storage controller?

choices.feedback_incorrect: The CPU executes instructions. A PCIe expansion card connects an additional interface or specialized device to the system.
RAM holds active working data. It does not provide the expansion interface described in the question.
A hard disk retains stored information. A PCIe card adds the interface or accelerator capability being tested here.

feedback_correct: PCIe expansion supports added capabilities such as networking, storage controllers and accelerators.
feedback_incorrect: Separate execution, working memory and storage from the role of an expansion card.
